description: Kratos builds unmanned aircraft, jet-powered drone targets, and satellite communications systems for the U.S. military. Its XQ-58 Valkyrie is a stealthy, low-cost autonomous aircraft designed as a 'loyal wingman' for manned fighters — capable of carrying sensors or weapons alongside F-35s. In January 2026 the U.S. Marine Corps selected Kratos and Northrop Grumman to develop its first operational Collaborative Combat Aircraft, graduating the Valkyrie from experimental program to procurement. Kratos also dominates the aerial target drone market (simulating enemy missiles for live-fire training) through its UTAP-22 and BQM-167 platforms.
note_on_ticker: The common retail shorthand '$KRATOS' is incorrect. The NYSE/NASDAQ ticker is KTOS.
